name: Stock
author: 1010music
description: Original Blackbox v3.12 color palette. Use as a reference or starting point for new themes.

0.description: Pad grid borders, cell outlines on PADS/FX/MIX screens. Subtle gray line.

1.description: Main interactive surface: piano white keys, KEYS grid cells, knob dial arcs, recording level meter bars. Near-black in stock.

2.description: Primary text EVERYWHERE: headers (1:1, Seq 1), param labels (LEVEL, PITCH), values, pad names, VEL label, toolbar text. Must contrast against both dark bg and cyan surfaces.

3.description: Selected/active row highlight background: highlighted setting on TOOLS, active scene on SONG, active FX slot, selected row on Conf/MOD. Hot pink in stock.

4.description: Primary interactive accent: vel slider fill, pressed key highlight, active toggle buttons (Loop1), file browser selection bar, active FX type button. The main cyan 'action' color.

5.description: Recording/alert red. REC button active state.

6.description: THE dominant surface fill: empty pad cells, toolbar/header bar bg, settings row bg, black piano keys, inactive tabs, mod indicator blocks. Cyan in stock — the most-used color in the entire UI.

7.description: Dark background behind parameter knob groups on Main/LFO/FX screens. Near-black in stock.

8.description: Secondary text for settings rows: Headphone, Out 1 Vol, Launch Mode labels and values on TOOLS/Conf screens. Gray in stock — more subdued than the white primary text [2].

9.description: Secondary accent: small indicator squares, subtle accent marks. Same cyan as [4] in stock.

10.description: Active/positive green: on states, playback active indicators.

11.description: Alert/negative red: recording state, error indicators.

12.description: Third dark background instance. Used for specific panel areas. Same near-black as [1] and [7] in stock.

13.description: True black. Deepest screen background behind all UI — PSET file list bg, empty Song area, base layer.

14.description: File/preset list item text (PSET browser names), settings value text. May also be 'before first selection' menu text. White in stock.

15.description: Divider/separator lines between rows in settings lists. Dark gray in stock.

16.description: Mid-level UI chrome: scroll indicators, secondary borders, disabled state elements. Medium gray in stock.

17.description: Second active/positive green instance. Pad active indicators, mute toggles. Same green as [10] in stock.

18.description: Second alert/negative red instance. Same red as [11] in stock.

19.description: Yellow highlight for sequence active steps or special indicators.

20.description: Third alert red instance. Clipping or destructive action indicators. Same red as [11] in stock.

21.description: Tertiary text / dimmed labels. Less prominent than [2] or [14]. Light gray in stock.

22.description: Pad/track color slot 1. Mint in stock. Used for per-pad coloring in mixer/sequences.

23.description: Pad/track color slot 2. Purple in stock. Used for per-pad coloring in mixer/sequences.

24.description: Inner fill of parameter knob boxes on Main/LFO screens. Slightly lighter than true black.

25.description: Dimmed accent background. Dark teal in stock — muted version of cyan behind vel slider track and other subtle accent areas.

26.description: Level/VU meter fill on recording screen. Same cyan as [4] in stock.

27.description: Special indicator. Olive/dark yellow in stock. Sequence step or specific UI state marker.

28.description: Mixer volume level bars on MIX screen. Same cyan as [4] in stock.

29.description: White text alternate: toolbar button text, tab labels, or value text in specific views. Same white as [14] in stock.

30.description: Active tab background on pad parameter screens (Main/Pos/LFO/Conf bottom tabs). Same cyan as [4] in stock.

31.description: Secondary accent highlight. Hot pink in stock. Same as [3]. Additional per-pad or UI highlighting.

32.description: Third white text instance. Tab or button text in specific views. Same white as [14] and [29] in stock.
